biggest_catch: You're paid only for minutes actually spent talking to a student — waiting online for calls earns nothing, and Cambly is currently limiting new tutor intake.
catches: Paid per talk-minute only ($0.17/min adults, $0.20/min Kids); time waiting for calls is unpaid.
Weekly payouts only process once at least $20 is owed — sub-$20 balances roll forward.
Cambly is temporarily limiting new tutors, so profile approval may take longer than usual.
No teaching degree required, but you must be a native English speaker with a camera, mic, and stable internet.
Cambly explicitly guarantees no minimum number of students or revenue.

eligibility: Native English speaker; computer/phone with camera, mic, stable internet; currently limited new-tutor intake.
maximize: Pick the weekly payout schedule in your settings — Cambly's own FAQ gives you the choice of every 1, 2, or 4 weeks, and weekly is the fastest money. Apply for Cambly Kids too: the official rate is $0.20/min versus $0.17 for adults, a straight 17% raise on the same minutes. Stay online during peak student hours (early morning US time catches Asian students, evenings catch Latin America) so more of your online time becomes paid talk-minutes instead of unpaid waiting.
notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Official evidence from support.cambly.com + cambly.com. Verified: concrete per-minute rates + bounded weekly payouts. Low hourly rate disclosed honestly. Distinct from Preply/iTalki/Preply-style marketplaces.

steps: Apply as a tutor at cambly.com (info form + short intro video).
Get approved and create your teacher profile.
Go online whenever you want — students call you for 1-on-1 English chats.
Earn per talk-minute ($0.17 adults / $0.20 Kids), tracked automatically.
Get paid weekly on Tuesdays via PayPal or Stripe once at least $20 is owed (choose 1-, 2-, or 4-week schedule).
timing: Weekly: earnings processed on Tuesdays via PayPal or Stripe once at least $20 is owed; tutors may choose 1-, 2-, or 4-week payout schedules.

who_pays: Cambly pays you $0.17 per minute for adults ($10.20/hour) and $0.20 per minute for Cambly Kids — per talk-minute only.
who_qualifies: A native English speaker with a computer or phone with camera, mic, and stable internet. No teaching degree required.
